senses.sense_definition: A type of white blood cell that plays a role in inflammatory reactions during an immune response.

examples.text: The doctor ordered a blood test to check the count of <w>basophils</w> in the patient's system.

target_lang_translations.zh: 医生开了一份验血单，以检查病人血液中<w>嗜碱性粒细胞</w>的计数。

examples.text: During an allergic reaction, <w>basophils</w> release chemicals that cause inflammation in the body.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在过敏反应期间，<w>嗜碱性粒细胞</w>会释放导致体内炎症的化学物质。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种白细胞，在免疫反应的炎症过程中起作用。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 免疫系统中的一种白细胞

senses.sense_definition: A type of endocrine cell found in the anterior pituitary gland that stains with basic dyes.

examples.text: The pituitary gland contains specialized <w>basophils</w> that secrete hormones regulating thyroid and reproductive functions.

target_lang_translations.zh: 垂体含有专门的<w>嗜碱性细胞</w>，它们分泌调节甲状腺和生殖功能的激素。

examples.text: Histological examination of the gland revealed a high density of <w>basophils</w> within the adenohypophysis.

target_lang_translations.zh: 对该腺体的组织学检查显示，腺垂体内有高密度的<w>嗜碱性细胞</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 垂体前叶中一种能被碱性染料染色的内分泌细胞。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 垂体前叶中能被碱性染料染色的细胞
